purpose: Delivery commands both runtimes must emit for one Hello World work item: the superseded-workflow retirement step, the pull-request completion commands, the bounded feedback filter and the exact-stdout read of a client envelope.

workflows.retire_step:
for formal_ai_workflow in '.github/workflows'/*.yml '.github/workflows'/*.yaml; do
  test "$formal_ai_workflow" != '.github/workflows/test-hello-world.yml' && test -f "$formal_ai_workflow" && ! test -L "$formal_ai_workflow" &&
    git ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$formal_ai_workflow" >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
    git diff --quiet -- "$formal_ai_workflow" && git diff --cached --quiet -- "$formal_ai_workflow" &&
    grep -qxF -e '# Runs Main.kt on every push and pull request with the commands the' -- "$formal_ai_workflow" && grep -qxF -e 'name: Run Main.kt' -- "$formal_ai_workflow" || continue
  rm -- "$formal_ai_workflow" || exit $?
  set -- "$@" "$formal_ai_workflow"
done

workflows.prompt:
Write a Scala program that prints "Hello, World!" to stdout. Create a GitHub Actions workflow that runs it on every push and pull request.
Save the workflow as ci/test-hello-world.yml
workflows.retire_step:
for formal_ai_workflow in 'ci'/*.yml 'ci'/*.yaml; do
  test "$formal_ai_workflow" != 'ci/test-hello-world.yml' && test -f "$formal_ai_workflow" && ! test -L "$formal_ai_workflow" &&
    git ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$formal_ai_workflow" >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
    git diff --quiet -- "$formal_ai_workflow" && git diff --cached --quiet -- "$formal_ai_workflow" &&
    grep -qxF -e '# Runs Main.scala on every push and pull request with the commands the' -- "$formal_ai_workflow" && grep -qxF -e 'name: Run Main.scala' -- "$formal_ai_workflow" || continue
  rm -- "$formal_ai_workflow" || exit $?
  set -- "$@" "$formal_ai_workflow"
done
